appearance.face: Rough, weather-beaten face. Unkempt full thick beard (络腮胡). Strong jawline, thick eyebrows, deep-set glaring eyes.
appearance.hair: Messy, thick dark hair tied roughly or loose.
appearance.body: Very tall, extremely muscular and broad-shouldered like an iron tower. Intimidating physical presence.
appearance.clothing: Sturdy, practical martial arts clothing or rough leather armor. Dark colors suitable for a fugitive guard.

personality: Extremely loyal to Shen Qingqi, fiercely protective, quick to anger, hates Xin Yueying deeply, blunt and straightforward.
signature_props: A long sword (usually kept sheathed unless provoked)
